# Hermes Optimizer

Hermes Optimizer is a provider-agnostic Hermes Agent skill that brings an install up to speed, or tunes an expensive one, in guided phases.

It works as a guided loop: read live state, ask what inspection cannot answer, act in the Desktop app, checkpoint with the user.

## What it does
- audits live config and reports honestly what is thin in a stock install
- runs seven phases: provider, auxiliary routing, plugins, document tooling, skills, guardrails, verification
- drives the Desktop app surfaces that own each setting
- detects configured providers and reachable models before recommending anything
- splits work into heavy / medium / light / vision lanes
- installs the plugin baseline that fills a real capability gap
- rejects heavy local installs that duplicate an already-live hosted route
- disables skills rather than deleting them, and states the enabled-versus-installed difference

## Modes
- Bring-up: a fresh or messy install, all seven phases
- Tune: a working install, only the phases that audit dirty

## Install
- `hermes skills install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzamatSafarov/hermes-optimizer/main/skills/hermes-optimizer/SKILL.md -y`
- `hermes skills tap add AzamatSafarov/hermes-optimizer`
